title: PREVAIL (BROKEN)
description: A beautiful fantasy RPG mod-pack with the player in mind.
body:
![sf](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ab9ad56a9d720b24411f69e0042495c80dc1a7c.png)

![divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b6be033ee36062fdaae778259d26cba281ed8cd.png)

**_A fresh Minecraft experience built for visuals, immersion, and exploration._**

This modpack will thrill you with amazing graphics, UI, and GUI. With the simple controls and gameplay, it is beginner-friendly and boomer-ready. This pack features enhanced physics, improved sound immersion, updated textures, new items, structures, and more. Welcome to PREVAIL.

---

<details>
  <summary>📦 Click to expand the feature list</summary>

## 🗒️ Features

- **Better menu**  
- **Enhanced UI**  
- **Tons of optimization**  
- **Beautiful, vibrant shaders**  
- **Realistic fishing:** Catch a live fish  
- **Better horses:** Enhanced riding, and you can now put them on a boat!  
- **Player animations:** Adds more life to your game  
- **Mob animations:** Also adds more life to your game  
- **Realistic physics**  
- **Appealing foliage**  
- **Dungeon structures to explore**  
- **Surface structures to explore**  
- **Elytra changes**  
- **Reimagined third person**  
- **Realistic first person**  
- **Dynamic lighting**  
- **Better and more particles and effects**  
- **Immersive snow**  
- **Immersive sound overhaul**  
- **Waystones:** Fast travel 
- **Impactful Combat**
- **Tweaks and fixes**  


🧩 _**And more to come...**_

</details>
